skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of real estate valuation, including the principles, methods, and processes involved in valuing real estate.
Analyze the factors influencing real estate values and market conditions.
Apply critical thinking to solve real estate valuation problems.
Develop and present comprehensive real estate valuation reports.
Work effectively in teams to complete real estate valuation projects.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral formats.
Understand and adhere to ethical standards in real estate valuation.
Make informed decisions based on real estate valuation data.
Manage real estate valuation projects from start to finish.
Apply financial analysis techniques to real estate valuation.
Use mathematical methods in real estate valuation.
Understand economic principles relevant to real estate valuation.
Apply legal knowledge to real estate valuation processes.
Conduct market research for real estate valuation.
Analyze data to support real estate valuation.
